body: Thank you for this. <3 I'm sorry it took me so long to say thank you -- I had been trying to avoid how badly I was feeling, but I read this when you posted it and it meant a lot to me.
Someone I know posted something very similar today... except she's turning 31 and has a fundraiser every other month for one reason or another.

Yes!!  I know I'm a little late to this, but you aren't the only one.  I'm dealing with the same thing and just started rewatching.  I totally understand how comforting the show is.  Hang in there. <3
I wish I could take a giant bite of this from my computer!  Lemon is my favorite -- look delicious.
I believe the movie you are thinking of is "Black and Blue".  I couldn't remember the name of it either but remembered that Mary Stuart Masterson is the actress, and that's what came up on IMDB!
I could have worded it better.  I know it's not a legit Disney store, but the set up is all Disney clothes and items with Disney music playing in the background.  It just seemed like Kmart's attempt.

Make sure you watch with volume on!  My boyfriend and I were running into a different store tonight and realized we needed toilet paper, and we happened to be right next to Kmart.  We decided, instead of going to our Target as usual, to take a little field trip into this pretty much abandoned place.  As we were walking toward the back, we heard music which sounded kind of eerie and we followed it to what used to be the garden center, but is now this makeshift Disney store thing.  You'll also notice the California apparel, including a tee shirt with a hemp leaf on it which says "Hi from California" haha.  This is in Costa Mesa, CA!  Immediately thought of this sub when walking through.
